messages:
maria.k: FYI started seeing weird token skips in staging after the kernel-selector change that prefers fp8 for activation matmuls.

david.t: Huh. perf numbers looked good though right? lower p50/p95 for generation.

maria.k: Yes, latency improved ~12% on average, but @anita noticed deterministic divergence vs baseline on long prefix tests.

anita: Repro: run ci/evals/long_prefix_check --model rwd-13b-mixprec --seq 2048 --batch 1. We see different tokens after step ~220.

lee_s: Can you paste the min diff log? also, which kernel variant was chosen at that time?

anita: Log snippet:

```
[2026-03-17T18:03:45Z] kernel_select: chosen=matmul_mixed_fp8_v3 (activation_quantized=true)
[2026-03-17T18:03:45Z] kv_cache: stored_entry=kv_0x7f8a (quant_meta=f8_s8)
[2026-03-17T18:03:46Z] step 219 output=..."you can"...
[2026-03-17T18:03:46Z] step 220 output=..."you'"...  <-- unexpected truncate
```

maria.k: Related observation: when batch>1 the issue disappears. Looks like batch/seq interplay is important.

david.t: That's suspicious — activation quant scales usually adapt to batch stats. Might be an offline calibration vs online stat mismatch.

lee_s: Also saw in profiler that for batch=1 we take the FP8 path but the dequant kernel used a different scale table (old vs new index) during KV restore.

anita: I captured an nvprof trace and comparing memory ops shows a misaligned memcpy right after kv restore for fp8 entries.

perf-bot: perf-alert: Increase in correctness regression test failures (long_prefix_check) on staging -> 7/100 failing runs since 1953199900.

maria.k: Hypothesis: the kernel-selector's heuristics changed the "kv packing" layout for fp8 entries (packed indices vs headerless) and the cache read path didn't bump the header flag -> shadowing old format.

david.t: That would explain why batch>1 is fine: the batching code hits a different, aligned copy path that normalizes format.

lee_s: Quick local repro that isolates the format mismatch:

```
# repro script
python -c "from rwd_serving import kv; kv.dump_format(0x7f8a); kv.restore(0x7f8a, assume_header=False)"
```

output:

```
format=packed_v2 header_flag=0 expected_header=1
warning: mismatched-scale-index -> silent cast
```

anita: Created a tiny unit test that flips the header flag and it reproduces the token shift.

maria.k: For mitigation we should hotfix selector to keep fp8 activation kernels disabled for batch==1 until probe coverage is fixed.

david.t: Agree. Can we also add an assert in kv restore to detect header mismatch in staging? Fail loud instead of silently dequantizing.

lee_s: Will open PR with both: revert heuristic + assert + repro test. Also adding a telemetry counter when format mismatch is seen.

anita: PR draft: rwd/serving#4821. Test added: tests/kv/test_format_compat.py::test_header_mismatch

deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued for channel=staging, tag=rwd-server@canary-19532

maria.k: Timeline: land PR, run canary on perf/long-prefix jobs (~2h), if green we can roll to prod. Also schedule a small audit of other kernel-selection changes (esp int8 paths).

david.t: Followup: we should audit calibration side-effects: when online scales collected under low-batch regimes are used to quantize activations, they might produce poor dynamic range for some heads -> correctness drift.

lee_s: Agreed. Add a calibration gate: only accept online scale updates if samples_seen >= 16 or batch_avg >= 2, whichever is first.

anita: I'll add that to the PR as a config flag: "min_stats_count_for_scale_update" default=16.

maria.k: Thanks. Also add an e2e with mixed precision + kv cache warmup to CI to cover this case (long prefixes, batch=1, alternate kernels).

perf-bot: Noted. Creating test job template: mixed-prec-kv-warmup-2048.

david.t: Good catch everyone. Any objections to the rollback heuristic? (disable fp8 activations for batch==1)

lee_s: No objections. I'll shepherd the rollback into the canary.

maria.k: OK. After canary we'll check perf impact numbers and open a follow-up to fix the format and enable fp8 safely.

anita: Leaving the failing run artifacts at s3://rwd-artifacts/staging/19532/ for debugging.

maria.k: Closing loop: ticket created INF-1298, assign to eng-runtime. Thanks all :thumbsup:
